sloka: स तु कोपेन चाविष्टः शोकेन च महाकपिः।हनुमान् रावणिरथे ऽपातयन्महतीं शिलाम् ।। ६.८२.९ ।।
transliteration: sa tu kopena cāviṣṭaḥ śokena ca mahākapiḥ।hanumān rāvaṇirathe 'pātayanmahatīṁ śilām ।। 6.82.9 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, overtaken by anger, filled with great sorrow hurled a huge rock at the chariot of Ravana's son.
